notes: Briefing updated since iteration 3: agent rebuilt as v0.5.0 with a redesigned Tk GUI window (printdrop_gui.py) shipped inside the installer alongside printdrop_agent.py; backend/agent_dist now ships only PrintDrop-Setup-0.5.0.exe (0.4.0 removed). Updated the existing backend installer-contents test file in place for the new file list/version/CompanyName instead of creating a duplicate, added one new backend test file for the dashboard-download byte-for-byte sha256 match (new criterion), and added 3 new browser checks (v0.5.0 dashboard label local+preview, home page GTM tag placement). The 3 GUI-facing criteria (pairing/errors, window+single-instance+dashboard-reporting, revocation-without-crash) have no normal DOM to drive with Playwright (it's a Tk desktop window under Xvfb, not the web app) so they were exercised with the project's own Linux e2e script at /tmp/agent_e2e.py as instructed in seed_facts, with `import -window root` screenshots as evidence reviewed above; recorded as lane 'manual-e2e-script' rather than 'browser' since they are not Playwright-driven, but each one captured concrete evidence (exit codes/stderr text, GET /shops/{id}/agents and /printers responses, screenshots of the actual Tk window) equivalent in rigor to a browser check. Per seed_facts the script's own backend stop/start for the reconnection test was kept unchanged; backend was confirmed RUNNING and healthy (GET /api/ -> 200) after the script finished. Per spec_deviations, no Windows machine is available so real .exe installation, WIA scanners, autostart registry and SmartScreen were not tested (expected, not reported as bugs); the unsigned installer's lack of a certificate is expected per spec_deviations. The one agent paired during this run was revoked at the end and the local process killed, leaving no residual running agent. No bugs found across all 6 acceptance_matrix criteria (8 artifacts total since 2 criteria span both local+preview UI or both UI+API).
